scripts.build:apk: tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build --mode capacitor && cap sync android
scripts.android:add: vite build --mode capacitor && cap add android && capacitor-assets generate --android --iconBackgroundColor '#070B14' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#070B14' --splashBackgroundColor '#070B14' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#070B14'
scripts.apk:debug: npm run build:apk && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run build:apk && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
